climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A large Western Australia zone containing Margaret River, Great Southern, Geographe, Manjimup, Pemberton and Blackwood Valley. In Great Southern, Geographe and Blackwood Valley, Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon lead plantings.
